integrity: Proof is self-contained apart from the classical prime number theorem and the established finiteness of the invariant. Exact finite checks supplement but do not certify infinite claims. Closely related published results are credited.
limitations: Lower bounds only, not an exact evaluation or an optimal logarithmic constant; explicit 413 cutoff is sufficient rather than sharp. Primitive nonnegative coefficients and coprime positive generators are essential.
title: Uniform primorial obstructions for primitive two-generator Frobenius numbers
